heroHeadline: Santa Cruz transport conditions Oct 5-6 strike on meeting with ministers as Morales' Decree 5716 deadline expires
heroSubtitle: As of Oct. 3, Santa Cruz transport leaders were awaiting a meeting with the government on repealing Decree 5716 before deciding whether to strike for 48 hours from Oct. 5. Evo Morales' Oct. 3 repeal deadline lapses, with a national mobilization announced from Oct. 13.
